company.name: Zoa Research
company.shortDescription: Zoa Research develops large-scale forecasting models that learn from diverse time-series data for quantitative prediction tasks.
company.description: Zoa Research develops large-scale, domain-agnostic forecasting models that learn from diverse time-series data. The company focuses on quantitative prediction engines that can be applied across many contexts rather than narrow, domain-specific models. Its platform powers forecasting applications such as trading and other quantitative decision problems. Zoa Research uses large models and automated optimization loops to handle the build-test-improve cycle with minimal manual feature engineering. The company aims to provide forecasting systems that rely less on human intuition and more on scalable inference-time compute. Its models are designed for organizations that depend on data-driven forecasting in fields such as finance, operations, and scientific experimentation.
